api:
OV.GeoUI.model (new and extended):
- squadShort(G): returns the existing {baseId, fit, seats, arriving} shape, or the new {baseId, fit, seats, arriving: null, craftId, idle} when a hangared transport carries fewer fit soldiers than min(seats, 6) while fit soldiers with no craft sit in the base.
- waitIsDefault(G, ref, nt, craft?) → bool. True in Recruta, or before G.ui.geo.nightTried is set. False when wreckage expires before dawn, or when the craft cannot wait that long on its fuel.
- loiterHours(G, craft) → hours the craft can still wait on site (same arithmetic as World.burnFuel).
- homeTransport(G, baseId) → the first hangared transport with soldiers aboard, or null.
- GEAR_KINDS: item kinds that count as combat gear.

OV.CampaignUI (new):
- reseedOnLoad(G) → load number. Salt for Campaign.reseedMap(G, 0x10000 + n). resume() applies it to every Geoscape load.
- leftAtBase(G, craft, pool) → [{id, n}], at most 4: usable weapons and gear left in base stores that are not aboard, weapons first, with their ammo.

OV.BaseUI.open(G, baseId?, tab?, {pick?, item?, equip?}): equip = craftId opens the Naves tab with that craft's equipment overlay.

Base buttons: btn({once: true}) uses a module-level guard that ignores event.detail > 1 and clicks less than 400 ms apart.

OV.Dom.toast: an identical non-'good' toast still on screen is re-armed instead of stacked.

G.ui.geo.nightTried (UI state): set when a night mission is launched from the craftArrived popup.

New i18n keys:
- geo.*: geo.alert.aboard.one/other, geo.short.title/risk/board/go, geo.ev.arrived.night.ask, geo.ev.arrived.night.fuel, geo.a.attackNow, geo.a.putAboard, geo.ev.delivery.gearHint, geo.tm.keys/.mouse/.touch, geo.dfBanner.text.touch, geo.ev.team.eta.night.flares.touch.one/other, geo.idle.toast.touch
- cp.*: cp.br.warn.short.one/other, cp.eq.leftAtBase, cp.mr.body.aria, cp.resume.geo.touch
- base.*: base.build.validHere.key, base.aria.ctx, base.tip.articleFor, base.research.sub.one/other (replaces base.research.sub), base.research.hint.finalMission.touch
- df.*: df.hint.modes.touch, df.hint.small.touch, df.hint.scrambleBig.touch, df.st.standoff.touch
summary:
All 16 round-3 findings are fixed. Each has a regression check in tools/tests/shell_persona_r3.test.js and/or qa/persona_r3_shell.mjs.

Test results:
- node tools/test.js --strict --i18n is green: 726 passed, 0 failed.
- qa/persona_r3_shell.mjs passed 113/113.
- These also pass: geo_check 37/37, base_ui_check 90/90, campaign_flow_check 127/0, dogfight_check 44/0, persona_r1_shell 85/85, persona_r2_shell 122/122, ui_wave4_check 74 checks.
- qa/full_campaign.mjs passes after one update to the script, described under #1 below.
- I looked at the screenshots at 1440×900, 1024×576, 1024×560 and iPad 834×1194 / 1194×834. They are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/ui4/persona_r3_shell/.

Per finding:
- #0 (2 soldiers sent): fixed.
  - Clicking the transport row with fewer fit soldiers than the estimated minimum no longer sends the craft. A confirmation opens first, with «Embarcar N e enviar» as the default (Enter). If nobody can board, «Cancelar» is the default and «Enviar assim» is the danger button.
  - The briefing now shows a 'bad' warning, «Só N soldados contra X–Y…», in place of the blue «lugares vazios» line.
  - squadShort now also catches fit soldiers left outside a hangared transport. The side panel shows a persistent warning with a one-click «Embarcar N e equipar».
- #1 (night Enter): fixed.
  - In Recruta, or before the first night mission, «Esperar pelo dia» is now first and is the Enter default. «Atacar já» (I) comes second, and a short question line is added.
  - The default switches back to attacking when wreckage expires before dawn, or when the craft's fuel will not last until dawn. The fuel case was found by full_campaign: waiting made the craft fly home. The popup now says so (geo.ev.arrived.night.fuel).
  - full_campaign.mjs relied on Enter starting the mission at night. It now picks «Esperar pelo dia» and starts at dawn.
- #2 (rocket launchers left at base): fixed.
  - The away-from-base equip screen now lists what stayed in the base stores and how to bring it. The note is clamped to 2 lines on short screens, with the full text in its tooltip.
  - The deliveryArrived popup for weapons has «Pôr na Skyranger-1» (E). It opens Base › Naves with that craft's equipment open.
- #3 (double click hires 10): fixed. The guard is now a btn({once}) option at module level. It applies to Contratar, Despedir, research start, production start (×1/×5/×10/∞) and Interrogar, as well as Comprar/Vender.
- #4 (same map after loading a manual save): fixed in the UI. CampaignUI.resume calls reseedOnLoad, a per-browser load counter used as the salt for Campaign.reseedMap. Loading the same manual save twice gives different maps; runs that never load stay deterministic. No sim change was needed.
- #5 (Geoscape side panel at 1024×560): fixed.
  - The side panel can now scroll, the contact lists keep a minimum height, and below 640 px high there is a single scroll with compact warnings.
  - Keyboard focus inside the panel is scrolled into view.
- #6 (monthly report keyboard): fixed. ↑/↓/PageUp/PageDown/Home/End scroll it, the body takes Tab focus with a visible outline, and the hint mentions the arrows.
- #7 (focus lost on the first project): fixed.
  - The real cause was that refresh() rebuilt the tabs, so focus fell to BODY. refresh() now restores focus by key, falling back to the active tab.
  - The research sheet opened with N from outside the content returns focus to «Novo projeto».
- #8 (build mode text and tooltip): fixed. With the keyboard, the text reads «Enter constrói · setas mudam a casa · Esc cancela». The tooltip is kept inside the window: left, or below/above the facility.
- #9 (globe target crosshair): fixed. Starting with G (or Enter on the button) shows the crosshair at once. A second line «Enter: escolher · Esc: cancelar» stays under the coordinates (mouse and touch variants too).
- #10 (accessible names without context): fixed for my screens. The scientist, engineer, quantity and cancel buttons and the Ufopédia buttons now include the project or article name. hud.report.show belongs to the battle fixer (patch in open issues).
- #11 (plural): fixed with Tn: «1 projeto disponível».
- #12 (Funding table in portrait): fixed. One column at 900 px wide or less, plus touch-action pan-x pan-y on the table box.
- #13 (keyboard-only texts on iPad): fixed. Touch variants added for the dogfight hints and standoff status, the open-interception banner, the night flares line, the idle-staff toast, the campaign-resumed toast and the final-mission hint.
- #14 (1/2/3 badges on iPad): fixed. .cp-diff-n is hidden under (hover:none).
- #15 (double tap on the sea): fixed.
  - The sea warning waits 340 ms and is cancelled by a double tap.
  - OV.Dom.toast no longer stacks an identical warning already on screen; 'good' confirmations still repeat.
  - The site-picking hint now teaches «Toque longo: centrar», the same gesture as the Geoscape.
deviations: #4 is fixed in the UI (CampaignUI.resume → reseedOnLoad, with the salt counter in localStorage 'ovni1999.loads' plus an in-memory fallback). This replaces the suggested sim change (G.loadCount in Save.load); I don't own save.js or campaign.js. Determinism holds for headless runs, which never load.

#1 adds a fuel condition that was not in the finding: «Esperar pelo dia» is not the default when the craft's fuel will not last until dawn, and the popup says so. qa/full_campaign.mjs exposed this: waiting sent the Skyranger home.

The research picker sheet keeps its call signature, so integration_r2.test.js (not mine) still matches. The return-focus rule changed to: return to «Novo projeto» when the sheet was opened from outside the content area or with no focus.
OV.Dom.toast deduplication is limited to non-'good' toasts, so two real hires still give two confirmations.
qa/full_campaign.mjs (owned) was updated: at night in Recruta the scripted player now picks «Esperar pelo dia» and starts the mission at dawn.
I ran one read-only `git status` to list my changed files; no git writes.

'hud.report.showRevealed.tip' : from >= 0 ? 'hud.report.showFrom.tip' : 'hud.report.show.tip') + ' — ' + ctx)`. Alternatively add 'hud.report.show.aria': 'Mostrar: {what}' to pt-PT.hud.js.
